title: Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026 sets out rules to reduce the environmental footprint of AI systems, covering data centers, hardware production, and AI-driven processes. It establishes standards for energy use, carbon emissions reporting, and promotes the adoption of greener AI technologies.

title: Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025 is a proposed law designed to prevent AI companies from charging excessively high prices and from manipulating wages. It seeks to protect consumers and workers by setting limits on AI service costs and ensuring fair labor practices.

title: FARM AI Act of 2026
action: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.
summary: The FARM AI Act of 2026 is a proposed law that seeks to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in the agricultural sector, ensuring that AI systems are applied safely, ethically, and transparently on farms. It aims to protect farmers’ privacy, promote responsible AI practices, and establish guidelines for AI-driven decision-making to boost productivity while safeguarding stakeholders’ interests.

title: Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act
action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 619.
summary: The Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act aims to encourage banks, insurers, and other finance firms to adopt AI tools by giving clear rules and incentives. It also sets up safeguards—like data‑privacy standards, ethical guidelines, and consumer protections—to ensure that new AI technologies are used safely and responsibly.

title: Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: The “Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act” is designed to encourage the use of artificial intelligence in banking, payments, and investment services by giving companies clear rules and incentives. It balances this push with protections for consumers and market integrity, ensuring that AI tools are deployed responsibly and safely.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Talent Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Talent Act is a law designed to boost the growth of AI by building a skilled workforce and encouraging research. It supports training programs, research funding, and policies that help people acquire the knowledge and experience needed to advance AI technology.

title: No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.
summary: The No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act prohibits the establishment or operation of AI data centers on federal land. The law seeks to protect environmental, security, and resource interests by restricting AI computing infrastructure from these public properties.

title: K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026
action: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 18 - 15.
summary: The K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026 aims to embed AI education across elementary and secondary schools, so students can learn how AI systems work, their benefits, and potential risks. The law also sets standards for schools to evaluate their technological readiness and responsibly integrate AI tools into everyday learning.

title: K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
summary: The K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026 is a law aimed at boosting students’ understanding of artificial intelligence and preparing schools to use AI tools responsibly. It outlines training programs for teachers, curriculum updates, and safeguards to help students learn about AI safely and effectively.

title: China AI Power Report Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
summary: The China AI Power Report Act requires AI developers and operators to disclose detailed information about the energy consumption and environmental impact of their AI systems. This policy aims to promote transparency, encourage energy efficiency, and help China meet its carbon‑reduction commitments while ensuring responsible AI deployment.

title: CREATE AI Act of 2025
action: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 29 - 0.
summary: The CREATE AI Act of 2025 establishes new rules for designing, testing, and using artificial‑intelligence systems to ensure they are safe, trustworthy, and transparent. It sets up oversight bodies and accountability standards so developers must prove their AI meets safety criteria before deployment.

title: A bill to provide for the delivery of artificial intelligence functional bills of materials, and for other purposes.
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.
summary: This bill requires that every AI system be accompanied by a functional bill of materials, detailing all its components, software versions, and data sources. The aim is to increase transparency, support accountability, and help regulators keep track of how AI systems are built and operated.

title: Understanding AI in the Classroom Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.
summary: The "Understanding AI in the Classroom Act" likely aims to guide teachers and schools on how to integrate and manage AI tools in educational settings. It probably establishes policies for responsible use, data privacy, and ensuring AI enhances learning without compromising student safety or academic integrity.

title: Children's Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act of 2026
action: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
summary: The Children’s Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act of 2026 sets strict safety and privacy rules for AI‑powered toys aimed at kids, requiring clear labeling and age‑appropriate design. It forces manufacturers to test and certify their toys, ensuring they are safe, transparent, and protect children’s data from misuse.

title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that every American and community impacted by the construction or operation of an artificial intelligence data center should have the right to transparency and local autonomy.
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The House of Representatives believes that all Americans and communities affected by the building or running of artificial‑intelligence data centers deserve a clear, open view of what is happening. They want those communities to have the power to influence decisions that directly impact them, ensuring local control and transparency.

title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Veterans Act of 2026
action: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
summary: This act aims to ensure that artificial intelligence technologies used in veterans' programs are deployed responsibly, emphasizing transparency, fairness, and data privacy. It establishes guidelines and oversight mechanisms to protect veterans’ rights while enabling innovative AI solutions to improve healthcare, benefits, and support services.

title: Safeguarding Against Fabricated Exploitation Through Artificial Intelligence Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
summary: The Safeguarding Against Fabricated Exploitation Through Artificial Intelligence Act of 2026 is a law that aims to protect people and organizations from being harmed by false or misleading claims that AI systems can generate. It sets out rules for detecting, preventing, and penalizing the creation and spread of AI‑generated content that could be used for exploitation or fraud.

title: Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026 establishes guidelines for how artificial intelligence tools can be used in the judicial system, ensuring they are safe, fair, and accountable. It sets up a dedicated oversight body that will monitor AI deployment in courts, review its impact on justice, and recommend policy updates as technology evolves.

title: Decoupling America's Artificial Intelligence Capabilities from China Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Decoupling America’s Artificial Intelligence Capabilities from China Act of 2025 aims to reduce the U.S. reliance on Chinese AI technologies and infrastructure. It seeks to strengthen domestic AI development, limit imports of key AI components from China, and bolster national security.

title: Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025 is a proposed law designed to stop companies from using computer algorithms to secretly coordinate pricing, output, or other business practices that harm competition. It would impose rules and penalties on firms that enable or engage in algorithm-driven collusion, aiming to keep markets fair and competitive.

title: Expanding AI Voices Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: The Expanding AI Voices Act aims to broaden the use of AI-generated voices across digital and media platforms, allowing for richer, more varied speech synthesis. It also establishes guidelines to ensure these voices are used responsibly, transparently, and with respect for user privacy.

title: Homestake AI Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
summary: The Homestake AI Act of 2026 is a new law that sets rules for how artificial intelligence can be developed and used in the United States, emphasizing safety, fairness, and public trust. It requires companies to disclose how their AI systems work, to protect user privacy and prevent harmful or biased outcomes, and to create oversight mechanisms that keep AI aligned with societal values.
